versions.subject: Windows Redcannary
versions.detection:
selection:
  DestinationPort: 
      - 25
      - 587
      - 465
      - 2525
  Initiated: 'true'
filter:
  Image|endswith:
    - \thunderbird.exe
    - \outlook.exe
condition: selection and not filter

versions.subject: fix: more Aurora FP fixes
versions.detection:
selection:
  DestinationPort: 
      - 25
      - 587
      - 465
      - 2525
  Initiated: 'true'
filter_clients:
  Image|endswith:
    - \thunderbird.exe
    - \outlook.exe
filter_mailserver:
  Image|startswith:
    - 'C:\Program Files\Microsoft\Exchange Server\'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter*
versions.spl: DestinationPort IN (25, 587, 465, 2525) Initiated="true" NOT (Image IN ("*\\thunderbird.exe", "*\\outlook.exe") OR Image="C:\\Program Files\\Microsoft\\Exchange Server\\*")
